proposals.title: Rename ExtentManagerV2 to ExtentManager in spec
proposals.rationale: The V2 suffix was intentionally removed from the component name during development. The spec lagged behind this deliberate naming decision.
proposals.change: Replace all occurrences of 'ExtentManagerV2' with 'ExtentManager' throughout the spec.

proposals.title: Update on-disk format version from 4 to 5 in spec
proposals.rationale: Code uses FORMAT_VERSION=5 with magic 'CERTUSV5'. The spec documented the previous version 4. This is a code-correct backfill.
proposals.change: Update magic constant from 0x4345_5254_5553_5634 ('CERTUSV4') to 0x4345_5254_5553_5635 ('CERTUSV5') and version field from 4 to 5 in both the Key Entities section and the Superblock table.

proposals.title: 100M extent scalability claim has no test verification
proposals.rationale: The spec claims ~100M extent support but no test exercises this scale. Options: (a) add a large-scale benchmark, (b) relax the claim to 'design supports' without a hard test, (c) accept the claim as an architectural statement. Requires human decision.

proposals.title: Unspecified code: used_bytes(), capacity_bytes(), FaultConfig, WriteHandle location
proposals.rationale: Several implemented features are not captured in the spec: used_bytes()/capacity_bytes() monitoring methods, FORMAT_VERSION=5 (now resolved), fault injection test infrastructure, and WriteHandle defined in the interfaces crate. Human decision needed on whether to add spec requirements for these.
